strings.Abats ce Hinox puis effectue une sauvega: Defeat this Hinox, then save your game. Its individual flag is used for Kilton’s Medal of Honor.
strings.Abats ce Lithorok puis effectue une sauv: Defeat this Stone Talus, then save your game. Attack the ore deposit on its body to deal damage.
strings.Abats d'abord le Sorcier pour éviter ses: Defeat the Wizzrobe first to prevent reinforcements, then use its fire weapon as a light source.
strings.Abats le Sorcier avec le feu avant qu'il: Defeat the Wizzrobe with fire before it summons reinforcements, then isolate the larger enemies.
strings.Accepte de jouer à cache-cache ou de cou: Agree to play hide-and-seek or run with it and follow the announced rule.
strings.Accomplis les trois défis indiqués : sui: Complete the three challenges indicated: follow the rings of light, reach dawn at the lake and defeat all the designated Guardians.
strings.Accomplis les trois défis indiqués : tir: Complete the three challenges indicated: shoot four targets in flight, descend Hebra Peak through the rings and shoot the fiery horn of Dinraal.
strings.Accomplis les trois défis indiqués : vai: Complete the three challenges indicated: defeat the Igneo Talus Titan, cross the rings above the lava and stay on the light near the Eldin Bridge.
Complete the three indicated challenges: defeat King Molduga, pass the rings on a sand walrus and take the orb back to the Yiga clan.
strings.Accès au club secret Gerudo: Access to the secret Gerudo club
strings.Accès au domaine Zora et ouverture de la: Access to the Zora domain and opening of the quest of Vah Ruta
strings.Accès au marchand, coffre, quête ou amii: Access to the corresponding merchant, vault, quest or amiibo
strings.Accès au sanctuaire central du château d: Access to the central shrine of Hyrule Castle
strings.Accès physique ; bombe ou arme possible: Physical access; bomb or weapon possible
strings.Accès physique au point indiqué: Physical access to the point indicated
strings.Accès à la bijouterie Le Joyau étoilé: Access to the jewelery The Starry Jewel
strings.Accès à la région ou au donjon concerné: Access to the region or dungeon concerned
strings.Achever la construction du village d'Euz: Complete the construction of the village of Tarrey Town
strings.Achète les pièces manquantes et vérifie: Buy the missing parts and check the conditions specific to the region.
strings.Achète les quatorze améliorations, dont: Purchase the fourteen improvements, including display racks, bed, door, lighting, trees and flowers, then still talk to Klavieh.
strings.Achète ou récolte une carotte tempo puis: Buy or gather a Swift Carrot and give it to Koko.
strings.Achète ou vend les matériaux utiles à to: Buy or sell materials that are useful for your next goal.
strings.Achète une épice Goron dans la boutique: Buy a Goron spice in the Goron City Shop.
strings.Actionne le cristal, emprunte le passage: Activate the crystal, take the side passage, and collect the Small Key.
strings.Active Polaris autour du point exact pou: Activate Magnesis around the exact point to bring out the chest under the ground.
strings.Active la carte, aligne les circuits des: Activate the map, align the circuits in the three cylinders to open the five terminals, then defeat Thunderblight Ganon and return to Riju.
strings.Active la carte, fais pivoter la Créatur: Activate the map, rotate the Divine Beast to reach its five terminals, then defeat Fireblight Ganon and return to Bludo.
strings.Active la carte, ouvre les cinq terminau: Activate the map, tilt the Divine Beast to access its five terminals, then defeat Windblight Ganon and speak to Kaneli again.
strings.Active la carte, règle la trompe et la r: Activate the map, adjust the trunk and wheel to access its five terminals, then defeat Waterblight Ganon and return to King Dorephan.
strings.Active la souche marquée par une feuille: Activate the strain marked by a leaf at the starting point.
strings.Active le déclencheur local jusqu'à ce q: Activate the local trigger until the chest becomes accessible.
strings.Active le gyroscope pour mesurer la qual: Enable the gyroscope to measure signal quality.
strings.Active le gyroscope seulement si nécessa: Activate the gyroscope only if necessary
strings.Active le point de téléportation, termin: Activate the teleport point, finish the test
strings.Activer la quête et garder son objectif: Activate the quest and keep your goal visible in the journal
strings.Activer un bonus d'attaque ou de défense: Activate an attack or defense bonus
strings.Activité répétable - réapparition à la l: Repeatable activity - reappearance at the blood moon
strings.Adapte l'esquive à chacune de ses deux a: Adapt the dodge to each of its two weapons and counterattacks only with a controlled rush.
strings.Adapte ta protection et tes flèches à la: Adapt your protection and arrows to the fire or ice variant.
strings.Affiche la carte de la tablette Sheikah: Open the Sheikah Slate map and activate Hero's Path Mode.
strings.Affichée mais exclue des scores finis: Displayed but excluded from finished scores
strings.Affiner les catégories choisies dans la: Refine the selected categories in the left column.
strings.Ajoute des objectifs depuis les résultat: Add goals from results or a record.
strings.Ajoute les résultats filtrés ou un objec: Add filtered results or a specific goal to a session, and then choose an optional starting point.
strings.Ajuste la trompe sur la carte, utilise C: Adjust the trunk using the map, use Cryonis or Magnesis as needed in each room, and collect the chest before changing the configuration.
strings.Ajuste ta position jusqu'à ce que le soc: Adjust your position until the pedestal activates and reveals Suma Sahma Shrine.
strings.Aligne les trois cylindres pour créer le: Align the three cylinders to create a passage or circuit, then use Magnesis and the electrical connections around the chest.
strings.Allume la marmite si nécessaire, puis co: Light the pot if necessary, then combine compatible ingredients.
strings.Allume la torche éteinte près de la prem: Turn the torch off near the first grid to open the path.
strings.Allume le fourneau du laboratoire et rep: Turn on the laboratory stove and talk to Purah again.
strings.Allume une torche à la flamme bleue du v: Light a torch with the village’s blue flame, activate the lanterns on the way and re-ignite the stove without crossing the water or rain.
strings.Allume, propage ou protège les flammes n: Light, spread or protect the necessary flames. Use Fire Arrows and block the water flow if needed.
strings.Allume-la avec une flèche de feu, une ar: Light it with an arrow of fire, a flaming weapon or a flame carried.
strings.Amiibo et mode Expert, séparés du 100 %: Amiibo and Expert mode, separated from the 100% main.
strings.Amène-lui un cheval ordinaire de taille: Bring him an ordinary horse of sufficient size, recorded or captured nearby.
strings.Ancien itinéraire transféré dans les don: Old route transferred in the application data
strings.Ancien slot ZXQ0QXZ modifié - slot ZXQ1Q: Old ZXQ0QXZ slot modified - ZXQ1QXZ slot preserved
strings.Angles croisés avec d'autres Gardiens du: Crossed angles with other Castle Guardians
strings.Anticipe sa trajectoire, approche-toi et: Anticipate its trajectory, approach and use Examiner when passing within range.

strings.Salle 13 - Salle active - 3 Nano Gardien: Room 13 - Combat room - 3 Guardian Scouts II: Move the metal crate to reach the hidden chest, then defeat the Guardians without wasting your strongest weapons.
strings.Salle 14 - Salle active - 4 Nano Gardien: Room 14 - Combat room - 4 Guardian Scouts I, 2 Guardian Scouts II: Focus your attacks on the Guardian Scout II enemies, and use the pillars to block their lines of fire.
strings.Salle 15 - Salle active - 2 Nano Gardien: Room 15 - Combat room - 2 Guardian Scouts III: Perform perfect dodges and take cover when the spinning attack begins.
strings.Salle 14 - Salle active - 2 Chuchus de g: Room 14 - Combat room - 2 Ice Chuchus, 1 Ice-Breath Lizalfos, 4 Blue Bokoblins, 1 Silver Moblin: Defeat the ice enemies with fire and collect the three Ancient Arrows from the chest.

compiled_strings.Atteins l'extrémité de la chaîne de stat: Reach the end of the chain of statues and activate Kema Zoos Shrine.
compiled_strings.Atteins l'île Finalis ; tout ton équipem: Reach Finalis Island; all equipment is temporarily removed upon arrival.
compiled_strings.Atteins l'île d'Edal au nord-est d'Akkal: Reach the island of Edal northeast of Akkala, preferably with stamina or an updraft.
compiled_strings.Atteins la dernière fleur blanche puis r: Reach for the last white flower and collect the Korok Seed from the Korok.
compiled_strings.Atteins la plateforme ou abats progressi: Reach the platform or gradually shoot the Octoroks to control its descent.
compiled_strings.Atteins la péninsule d'Uzmi au nord-est: Reach Rist Peninsula in northeastern Akkala and read the stone tablet.
compiled_strings.Atteins la salle centrale et active le s: Reach the central room and activate Dila Maag Shrine.
Reach the central room and activate the Qaza Tokki Shrine shrine.
compiled_strings.Atteins le plateau du Tonnerre sous l'or: Reach the Thunder Plateau under the storm and spot the four colorful orbs.
compiled_strings.Atteins le sanctuaire de Hiro'Hira au ce: Reach the Hila Rao Shrine shrine in the center of the field.
compiled_strings.Atteins le sanctuaire de Mahmu'Lano avec: Reach for Maag Halan Shrine's shrine with the test equipment still in your possession.
compiled_strings.Atteins le sommet dans les conditions de: Reach the top in the conditions required to reveal Gorae Torr Shrine.
Reach the top and join the altar.
compiled_strings.Attends environ 15 h puis place-toi sur: Wait until about 3:00 PM, then stand on the pedestal when the tower's shadow passes over it.
compiled_strings.Attends l'enregistrement automatique ou: Wait for automatic recording or make a backup.
compiled_strings.Attends l'enregistrement du symbole de c: Wait for the check-in of the chest symbol next to the shrine.
compiled_strings.Attends la nuit complète : le squelette: Wait for the full night: the inert skeleton during the day cannot be fought normally.
compiled_strings.Attends qu'Oaki atteigne seul le sanctua: Wait for Oaki to reach Daag Chokah Shrine alone, then join him.
compiled_strings.Attends qu'elle cuisine la soupe de légu: Wait for her to cook the vegetable soup, then accept the dish.
compiled_strings.Attends qu'il ne pleuve pas puis allume: Wait until it does not rain and then light with arrows of fire the four torches around the statue of the Goddess.
compiled_strings.Attends que le passage soit dégagé, puis: Wait until the passage is cleared, then open the chest.
compiled_strings.Attends que le tonneau s'élève suffisamm: Wait until the barrel rises high enough to satisfy Shamae.
compiled_strings.Attends une nuit de lune de sang et reti: Wait for a blood moon night and remove all equipment, including weapons, bow, shield and clothing.
compiled_strings.Attire-le avec une bombe au sol, fais-la: Draw him with a bomb on the ground, detonate it when he jumps and then attacks his belly.
compiled_strings.Attrape dix lézards ignifus en soulevant: Catch ten fiery lizards by lifting stones or moving discreetly into the mine.
compiled_strings.Aucun point de sauvegarde : mourir recom: No save point: dying starts the level again from its first room.
compiled_strings.Aucune coordonnée fiable n'est disponibl: No reliable co-ordinates are available for this purpose.
compiled_strings.AutoPlacementMgr choisit les apparitions: AutoPlacementMgr selects the appearances according to the area and the status of the quest; they have no permanent coordinates and are voluntarily excluded.

compiled_strings.Phase 1 : bloque ou esquive ses trois ac: Phase 1: blocks or dodges all three accelerations, then counterattacks when it stops within range.
compiled_strings.Phase 1 : décoche une flèche lorsque son: Phase 1: Shoot an arrow when its rock appears above it, then hit it during its fall.
compiled_strings.Phase 1 : déplace-toi entre les piliers,: Phase 1: Move between the pillars, avoid projectiles and aim at the eye when it materializes its cannon.
compiled_strings.Phase 1 : esquive ses attaques rapproché: Phase 1: Dodge close attacks and hit after teleportations; a dropped banana can create an opening.
compiled_strings.Phase 1 : esquive son épée et frappe apr: Phase 1: Dodge his sword and strike after its sequences; an arrow in the eye creates an opening.
compiled_strings.Phase 1 : reste près du corps du boss, é: Phase 1: Stay close to the boss's body, avoid spear sweeps, and hit after its sequences are over.
compiled_strings.Phase 2 : attends que les deux rochers t: Phase 2: Wait for the two rotating rocks to line up above it before shooting and attacking.
compiled_strings.Phase 2 : crée des piliers Cryonis entre: Phase 2: Creates Cryonis pillars between platforms, destroys ice blocks with Cryonis and then aims at the eye.
compiled_strings.Phase 2 : lorsqu'il aspire l'air derrièr: Phase 2: When sucking the air behind its barrier, throw a bomb into the suction and then trigger it.
compiled_strings.Phase 2 : prends un pilier métallique av: Phase 2: Take a metal pillar with Magnesis and hold it close to the boss so that his own lightning breaks his guard.
compiled_strings.Phase 2 : utilise les courants ascendant: Phase 2: Use updrafts to shoot in slow motion and destroy projectiles before they surround you.
compiled_strings.Phase 2 : élimine rapidement les clones: Phase 2: quickly defeat the clones. The real monk keeps his health bar and remains the target of your lock-on.
compiled_strings.Phase 3 : saisis avec Polaris la boule m: Phase 3: grasp the bristled metal ball with Magnesis and fold it over until the final cut.
compiled_strings.Phase 3 : utilise les piliers et la para: Phase 3: Use the pillars and the Paraglider against its giant size, then aim it in the middle of the jump before attacking the ground.
